title: Animated film "Scavengers"
content: ScavengersfromJoseph BennettonVimeo."Scavengers" is an animated short that presents human explorers dealing with a strange alien biology on a foreign planet. (Link to Vimeo) Part of the effectiveness of the film comes from the decision not to use spoken language and very little music, focusing instead on concrete sound effects.ViaCartoon Brew
